intent: Validate remaining acceptance, revision and restart stages without repeating already observed model work solely to repair reporting.
preparationRequiredBeforeRequestingExecu: Build and independently seal a new candidate ASAR from reviewed source; keep installed base frozen.
Create a new bounded subset runner; existing sealed six-case runner cannot be edited or silently reused as a subset.
Offline-test identity, native command receipts, zero-model F04 transport guard, budget accounting and all stop boundaries, then independently review exact candidate/runner/sample hashes.
Obtain fresh explicit authorization; closed live-round and gate budgets are not reusable.

stages.kind: Human acceptance of previously qualified historical draft in isolated new-candidate copy
requirements: User explicitly selects the named candidate window and matching F04 task.
Transport guard rejects any unexpected model attempt before dispatch.
Human clicks accept; capture candidate/profile/task identity, native command acknowledgement, journal commit/event ID, snapshot/history, full export and cold-restart state.
Do not automate the human action or count this as fresh end-to-end model business acceptance.
Run only after F04-local passes and the user is ready.
Bind gate to the new candidate, then independently review before business stages.

stages.window: Shared fixed 45-minute business window with F06
requirements: Use original sealed F05 input and revision path.
Check prior report invalidation, revised evidence binding, independent recheck, human acceptance and exported hash.
If marker confirmation/recheck is not naturally reached, report it as not covered; do not spend calls to force coverage.

stages.window: Shared fixed 45-minute business window with F05
requirements: Verify cold restart before advancement and at pending acceptance, correct task identity, durable human receipt and export integrity.

windowRules: Each window starts only when the user can operate the candidate; it includes human actions and independent-review waits.
Each phase window is fixed and cannot be reset or extended.
Budgets are per stage and combined; unused allowances do not authorize new stages or retries.
stops: Any budget threshold or window exhausted
Second marker-confirmation wait in the same stage
notRepeated: F01 and F02 fixed invalid drafts
F03 model generation and verification: original raw report has passed offline export replay

reporting.F04: Historical qualified-draft human-operation chain, reported separately; not a new model case.
reporting.F05F06: New unfinished workflow completion denominator is 2. Initial and revised F05 drafts are separately assessed.
reporting.falseRelease: No new fixed-invalid samples: fixed-invalid release rate is not measured. If generated invalid-draft denominator is zero, report not estimable, never 0%.
reporting.historical: Do not combine different candidates/rounds into a six-of-six pass or overwrite old denominators.
reporting.deployment: No installation, formal main evaluation or release implied.
